findings.detail: Task 3 cwd/profiles modules and cwd/IPC tests are absent. Registry still has no terminal role; pure TerminalPolicy is not native admission.
ownedDirectory rejects leaf symlink and changed realpath but does not retain directory identity or atomically bind later spawn to the checked directory.

Candidate PowerShell uses an environment-derived path with C:/Windows fallback, exact case-sensitive injection stripping and forced PSModulePath. This is probe code, not a production profile authority.
No cwd/profile success can replace actual PTY ownership/ABI/package qualification. Session ledger explicitly reports nativeExecutionAdmitted:false.

signatures.compatibility: Approved public pick/resolve/list/resolve methods remain unchanged; new constructor adapters/lifecycle names are recommendations, not implemented or previously approved new IPC.

cwdChecks.authority: Opaque native-issued ID -> private app-run/project/epoch/admission record; displayPath has no authority.
cwdChecks.scope: Pick retains its originating captured native scope across every await. Resolution may use another eligible same-project view; do not tie project token solely to originating window.
cwdChecks.protectedRoots: Native canonical active Data root plus native installation App/runtime/resource/generated roots, including inactive version directories where applicable; never renderer payload.
cwdChecks.boundary: Equality or path-component descendant, never naive startsWith; validate roots and both selected/canonical forms; fail closed on missing/unknown protection roots.
cwdChecks.revalidation: Inspect canonical directory and relevant ancestor identities at pick, again at resolve and immediately before manager host-create; compare remembered identity/canonical path and recheck native admission after all awaits.
cwdChecks.raceLimit: Path-only Node/PTY spawn leaves a filesystem TOCTOU interval. File IDs/fingerprints and repeated checks narrow detection; only separately demonstrated native handle/race policy can justify an atomic guarantee.
cwdChecks.noSandbox: Initial cwd protection is not a restriction on later cd or reads available to the OS user.
cwdChecks.noFallback: No process.cwd/user home/temp/blob/runtime fallback or automatic creation/materialization.

profileChecks.primary: Absolute Windows PowerShell discovered from trusted native OS/system-directory input, verified existing canonical regular executable; no PATH/where/cwd lookup and no C:/Windows guessed fallback.
profileChecks.optional: PowerShell 7/cmd absent until exact main-owned discovery and fixed argv policy; unavailable primary does not silently change shell.
profileChecks.environment: Copied native-owned OS snapshot; case-insensitive removal of Node/Electron injection and application-injected credentials, preserve required OS vars/PATH, no renderer env; no mutation of process.env.
profileChecks.psModulePath: Candidate forces OS-only modules to avoid its Codex environment. For production, explicitly remove only application-injected module paths or qualify OS-only policy; do not silently copy fixture restriction and claim compatibility with user-installed modules.
profileChecks.finite: Only metadata profileId/label/available crosses to renderer; native executable/args/env remain private, revalidated for each create.

testCases: Native dialog cancellation/empty/multiple selection never substitutes cwd; no host side effect.
Windows drive roots C:/ and D:/, Unicode/combining characters/emoji, spaces/apostrophe/backtick/$() remain literal path arguments; no command construction.
Relative, drive-relative, rooted-without-drive, device/extended namespace, NUL/control/unpaired-surrogate paths refuse; UNC policy explicit rather than silently rewritten.
Canonical Data/runtime equality and descendants refuse; prefix siblings Data-other/App-old allowed; case and separator variants cannot bypass boundaries.
Leaf symlink, junction ancestor, replaced protected-root alias, and same-path different identity refuse; inaccessible/deleted/file/unknown identity refuse.
Known path changes during lstat/realpath/profile/picker awaits return ACCESS_REFUSED or CWD_CHANGED; no usable late grant.
Lock then rollback, project A→B→A, retired frame and copied native-grant object never resurrect a pending picker or cwd token.
Project-bound cwd is usable by another eligible current project view under native policy, not by foreign projects or Docs/Code/Presenter/Audience.
Bound cwd grant map with deterministic capacity refusal, no eviction of active session authority; revoke on Lock/project transition/dispose.
PowerShell executable absolute and owned regular file; SystemRoot absent/malformed, executable absent/replaced/link/protected-root candidate => unavailable with no PATH/cwd search.
Optional pwsh/cmd unavailable until separate exact discovery/argv inventory; never silently substitute another shell.
Exact immutable PowerShell args [-NoLogo,-NoProfile]; no Command, File, NonInteractive, execution-policy override, user startup commands or imported content.
Mixed-case NODE_/ELECTRON_/VSCODE_ injection entries stripped; duplicate case-folded environment keys refuse or deterministically canonicalize; required OS vars retained.
App credentials/PIN/tokens/project snapshots absent from shell envelope and logs; sanitize never mutates process.env and rejects non-data/getter-bearing malformed snapshot.
Executable revalidation finishes before final current/admission checks; profile list results rechecked after awaits; no Promise/object truthiness authority.
nextSteps: Implement pure cwd/profile authorities with fail-closed adapters and independent filesystem/OS snapshots; preserve no product shell admission.
Write focused RED tests for path/identity/env and native-await revalidation; fake spawnCount proves dispatch absence only.
Wire registry terminal role and dedicated exact IPC only after owner guard readiness, preserving independent WebContents identities and Lock transitions.
Qualify actual Unicode/junction/executable discovery/environment behavior in isolated actual runtime, then exact packaged bytes; do not infer it from pure tests.
